## What problem does this solve?

Describe the user pain. Avoid jumping straight to a solution.

## Proposed solution

Your idea, if you have one. UI mockup / API shape welcome.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why they're worse.

## Scope check

- [ ] Fits the existing tool's purpose (DB import/export, plugins, etc.)
- [ ] Not blocked on a missing dependency we'd want to avoid
- [ ] You're willing to help / send a PR (optional but appreciated)

## Additional context

Anything else.
